text:
Tariq: Quick heads-up — Pelotonix renewal arrived but PO PX-2026-99 lists "quarterly invoice" and VAT handling that doesn't match our quote (annual prepaid). Procurement also attached a signed scan but left billing GL blank. Can billing/legal advise?
Elena: Noted. They changed to quarterly invoicing on the PO text. Our signed quote (SOW-874) is annual prepaid. If we accept quarterly we need an amendment and pricing recalculation.
Maya: Onboarding at 60% — feature enablement scheduled in 3 business days. If docs slip we'll need to delay. CSM-bot, flag customer comms?
CSM-bot: Flagged for CSM: "Possible 48-72h delay if paperwork not reconciled". Template prepared.
BillingBot: FIN ticket FIN-4922 created to track VAT/GL mismatch. We cannot invoice without GL code. Also VAT country differs from customer profile; finance needs VAT ID confirmation.
LegalAssist: Two paths: a) ask procurement to correct PO to match 12mo prepaid and include GL + VAT ID; b) accept current PO as acknowledgement but sign a short amendment documenting quarterly billing and adjusted MRR. Recommend (a) to avoid pricing changes. Can draft one-liner amendment if they insist on quarterly.
Tariq: I'll ping procurement contact (procure@pelotonix.ai) and request corrected PO to match SOW-874 and explicit GL/VAT fields. If they push quarterly, we'll need a pricing sign-off from RevOps.
Elena: If they insist on quarterly we need RevOps and Sales approval for pro-rated schedule. Tagging RevOps: @Maya can you loop them in?
Maya: Looping RevOps now. Also told the onboarding team to prepare a contingency hold.
Tariq: Update: procurement replied — they uploaded a scanned signature but said their ERP enforces quarterly invoices for renewals unless a contract amendment is provided. They can add GL code but not change invoice cadence without an amendment.
LegalAssist: Ok. Drafting amendment that allows annual prepaid price but permits quarterly invoicing schedule for a single renewal cycle, with explicit VAT handling. Will post redline.
BillingBot: FIN-4922 updated: awaiting GL code and confirmation of VAT ID; will accept GL via procurement portal note.
Tariq: Procurement uploaded GL code (sent to finance@redwood.com) and VAT ID. Forwarded to thread.
Elena: Finance confirmed VAT ID matches. We still need RevOps approval to accept quarterly billing while keeping annual pricing.
Maya: RevOps approved a one-time quarterly invoice schedule at the same annual total, with payments spread over quarters, provided amendment is signed and SOW references the payment schedule.
LegalAssist: Amendment uploaded: /docs/amendments/PX_99_invoice_schedule_addendum_v1.docx. Key clause: "Notwithstanding prior SOW, Parties agree to a one-time quarterly invoicing schedule for Renewal PX-2026-99; total contract value remains as agreed in SOW-874; VAT handling per Annex A." Ready for exec sign.
Tariq: Great. Action items: Legal to countersign, Billing to process GL/VAT, CSM to hold feature rollout window if signed later than EOD.
BillingBot: FIN-4922 closed after amendment countersign and GL confirmed.
Maya: Onboarding hold lifted. Release scheduled as planned. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
